caveats: logical lengths are not allocated/compressed disk blocks
existing bytes already reduce observed free disk; logical accounting does not allocate them again
stat observations span enumeration and are not an atomic snapshot or capacity reservation
runtime allocations are included by stat only; no environment/configuration/payload content was opened
other worktrees/jobs and future writes are not enumerated as launch permission; refresh immediately before any approved receipt

inventory.method: stat-only regular-file logical lengths; no payload/config/credential contents opened; directory names classify allocation only; metadata digest is not a payload digest

machine.processInventory: not-inspected; no commands, credentials or account configuration read
